name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Restores the friend-request system (connect by URL, each side mints an API key for the other automatically on accept, no manual copy-paste) and friends-of-friends discovery, withdrawn in 0.0.27 to stabilize a critical crash fix that shipped in the same release. This is a careful forward-port, not a revert: the withdrawal commit also deleted the plugin subclasses that were crashing every federated item, and 34 releases have touched the same files since (WAN caps, streaming modes, dedup) - reverting outright would have reintroduced that crash and conflicted with everything built since. FederationFriendService, its 8 Friends/* endpoints, the config-page UI, and its full test suite (18 tests) are all back and adapted to today's codebase. Also fixes a real bug found while restoring this: two migration flags (MigratedRemoveShortcutV9, MigratedPlaceholderPathV10) were never added to the config-save endpoint's server-internal-state preservation list, so every settings save from the UI silently reset them - re-triggering a full rebuild of every WAN-capped/shortcut-affected federated item on the next sync after any unrelated change.
